title: Scutellaria baicalensis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Scutellaria baicalensis tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the roots of the Scutellaria baicalensis plant, commonly known as Chinese skullcap. It is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine and modern herbalism for its purported anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The tincture is often taken orally to support immune function, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety or inflammation. It is also used topically for skin conditions and as a supportive treatment for respiratory and digestive ailments. Due to its potent nature, it is typically diluted before use and should be handled with care.
